decisions.decision: DocumentReadResult should remain a minimal runtime intermediate shape rather than a rigid markdown schema.
decisions.rationale: Runtime needs a stable handoff from LLM reading results while keeping document semantics soft and markdown-first.

decisions.rationale: This extends Kairos toward document-driven orchestration without deleting or destabilizing the existing todo/demo workflow branches.
